llmnav-catalog/1 repository=workduck catalog=workduck.agent
Read semantic cards before opening source. Resolve current paths and signatures with llmnav query or show.

@workduck.agent.adapters
role Export agent briefs and AGENTS.md documents for supported coding hosts without granting execution authority.
owns agent adapter profiles, brief export formats, AGENTS.md compilation
excludes agent process execution, provider credentials
invariant Every adapter remains export-only and declares its supported artifacts through an explicit profile.

@workduck.agent.snapshot
role Build a bounded read-only workspace snapshot for agents while omitting secrets, terminal input, command text, and output bodies.
owns agent API snapshot, workspace summary redaction, snapshot capability declaration
excludes workspace mutation endpoints, secret decryption
invariant Snapshot generation never creates missing Queue state or exposes secret identifiers, encrypted payloads, commands, or output tails.
risk privacy
rel test>workduck.agent.snapshot.contract

@workduck.agent.snapshot.contract
role Verify the agent snapshot replaces credential references with presence flags and never serializes their secret identifiers.
